bullets: Asia/Europe rallied on Nvidia's 31.5% surge after Huang's CEO return (Nikkei +3%, Euro Stoxx futures +2.3%), but US futures are flat-to-lower, signaling consolidation.
Oil slid to ~$80/bbl, easing inflation worries and lifting Treasuries even as the 10Y yield ticked up toward ~4.95%.
VIX plunged ~26% from Monday's spike, showing fear fading fast after the AI-led rebound; risk appetite improved sharply.
Key data: CB Consumer Confidence today, then Core PCE and Prelim GDP tomorrow (Nov25) - both high-impact for the rate path.
